en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional fishing scene on the seashore: a sailing boat with a large triangular sail is close to the waterline while fishermen work on board. In the foreground, a man guides a team of oxen pulling something from the shallow water. Additional small boats are visible on the horizon. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Valencia and labels the scene as "Pesca del Bou"; a small imprint "DURA" appears at the lower right.
